title: refactor: shared one-shot AI CLI launcher (titles + theme expert)
body:
Extract one shared one-shot AI CLI launcher (claude -p / codex exec / grok) used by both src/terminal_titles.rs (command_spec) and src/theme_expert.rs (generate). Today the provider flag lists are duplicated and already differ; the commit-message button (next card) would be a third copy.
- Base it on terminal_titles.rs command_spec (persisted title_provider + model, per-provider tests).
- Keep: bounded output, timeout, restricted tools, npm_codex resolution, CREATE_NO_WINDOW, background thread.
- Callers pass prompt + cwd; the launcher returns text. Each caller keeps its own output validation.
- No behavior change for title naming or the theme expert; existing tests stay green.
